assumptions.notes: All unmeasured assumptions. 120 g per rotating wheel is user starting estimate. Print density is an effective bulk estimate, not an infill calculation. Brake is ideal joint friction; no cam/contact validation.

limitations: CAD visual meshes simplified with a 0.25 mm vertex grid; not manufacturing geometry
Bounding-box inertias; no calibrated mass properties
Capsule/box/cylinder collision proxies; not CAD interference validation
Ideal IMU and joint feedback, not evidence of sensors on real servos
Brake friction torque surrogate, no cam deformation, spring or pad model
Steering 40T/40T ideal joint equality; no backlash
